comments.author: JS
comments.body:
the purpose of the chart is to show the basic trends of the market's supply/demand.

positive arrows means that city supplies that type of good, negative means they use that type of good and need some imported. larger the +/- value the greater the rate of supply/demand.

Percentages indicate their baseline stock level need. so in instances where the town supplies a good type the higher above the base stock level the better the trade ratio you will get. On the other hand, where a town needs to import an item, the further below the base stock level the better exchange ratio you will get.

trade ratio then will be based off these 2 things combined with the value each nation applies to specific goods. IE in japan they like their wine more than all other alcohols.
